description: The real 2048 puzzle — slide tiles with arrows or swipe, merge matching numbers, and chase the 2048 tile. Score and best saved.

faqs.a: Arrow keys (or WASD) on desktop, swipe on mobile. Every move slides all tiles and merges matching pairs.
You win when you create the 2048 tile — but you can keep playing for a higher score after that.
Your best score is saved in this browser.
Yes — touch swipe is fully supported.

howto: Slide tiles with arrow keys or swipe.
Matching tiles merge into their sum.
Reach 2048 to win — then keep going!
title: 2048 Game
